what: Grid points of the Ifremer WAVEWATCH III hindcast GLOBMULTI_ERA5_GLOBCUR_01 (GLOB-30M, 0.5°, 3-hourly, 1993–2024) — the dataset of Reis, Guimarães et al., Ocean Engineering 2026 — at which the significant wave height series is extracted by tools/fetch-ww3-points.py. Each point is a node of the model's own grid (latitude −78 + 0.5 j, longitude −180 + 0.5 i); nothing is interpolated.

points.name: campos
points.why: Campos Basin, deep water off Rio de Janeiro

points.name: pelotas
points.why: Pelotas Basin, off Rio Grande do Sul

points.name: potiguar
points.why: equatorial margin, off Rio Grande do Norte

points.name: drake
points.why: Drake Passage — the paper names a region of Gumbel predominance here

points.name: acc-central
points.why: central band of the Antarctic Circumpolar Current — the paper's exponentiated-Weibull band

points.name: southern-high
points.why: higher southern latitudes — the paper names the generalized gamma prominent there

points.name: subantarctic-north
points.why: northern sub-Antarctic — the paper's lognormal band

points.name: arabian-sea
points.why: monsoon-driven; the paper describes the exponentiated Weibull giving way to the Weibull as blocks grow

points.name: south-of-japan
points.why: western Pacific south of Japan — the paper's region where return levels rise with block size
